# Account Type Empty Edit Enable
In SuzhouHousingG admin, account type field disabled on empty historical data caused save failure due to required validation.
## Root Cause
- Account type auto-generated from user code, edit mode disabled by default.
- When historical `accountType` empty, field remained disabled but validation required, blocking save.
## Fix
- In `src/views/system/user/detail.vue`, `isAccountTypeDisabled` now enables edit when `originForm.accountType` empty.
- Empty case uses `accountTypeOptions` from `sys_account_type` dict; `isAccountTypeEmpty` unified empty check.
- `detailCallback` end assigns `originForm`.
## Involved Files
- `src/views/system/user/detail.vue`, `src/mixins/detailMixins.js`, `src/views/company/userManagement/operator/detail.vue`
- `src/views/system/user/index.vue`, `operatorAddDialog.vue`, `src/utils/terminalUser.js`, `src/mixins/form.js`, `src/components/zs-select/zs-select.vue`
## Verification
- Source: 苏住房G/062.md; session 08df6a66-6dbe-4a03-8d68-a6fa9506abe6.

# Receipt Button Outside Disabled Form
In SuzhouHousingG `pubBankReceiptApply` detail page, buttons inside disabled form were unclickable in view mode.
## Root Cause
- Query and get receipt detail buttons located inside disabled form, so in view mode they were not clickable, detail list not shown.
## Fix
- Move buttons out of disabled form.
## Involved Files
- `src/views/benefit/pubBankReceiptApply/detail.vue`, `components/detailTable.vue`
- `src/api/benefit/pubBankReceiptApply.js`, `src/api/benefit/pubBankReceiptDetail.js`
- `src/mixins/detailMixins.js`, `src/views/benefit/pubVerificationReceipts/detail.vue`, `src/mixins/form.js`, `src/components/zs-button/zs-button.vue`
## Verification
- Source: 苏住房G/062.md; session 765750a0-13d8-4789-8d78-9bb82bdf1e1f.

# Company List Date Span Limit 2 Days
In SuzhouHousingG `companyListQuery.js`, date span restricted to 2 days with overdue dates greyed out.
## Change
- Constant `TWO_YEARS_MS` changed to `TWO_DAYS_MS`; anchor on first selected day.
- Dates diff >2 days greyed out; search validation prompts "更新时间跨度最多可选择2天".
- 6 Vue pages sharing util auto-affected; trust/index.vue without `enableAdvancedQuery` has no filter, but limited after enabling.
## Involved Files
- `src/utils/companyListQuery.js`
- `src/views/company/companyManagement/property/index.vue`, `components/index.vue`, `change/index.vue`, `trust/index.vue`
- `src/views/company/companyRegister/index.vue`, `src/views/company/staffManagement/components/index.vue`
## Verification
- Source: 苏住房G/063.md; session 84fe40ac-f546-41bc-9d7e-76bd876f4594.

# 多套同类规则共用列表组件时按钮文案须从枚举派生
苏住房G项目中业主自治-规约管理下管理规约/议事规则/工作规则三套规则共用同一列表组件，按钮中文名写死导致串味，须从类型枚举派生。

## 问题背景
- 管理规约/议事规则/工作规则三套规则共用 src/views/autonomy/regulation/components/index.vue，靠路由传入 regulationType 区分
- 列表顶部「已备案XX」按钮写死成「已备案管理规约」，导致议事规则/工作规则页也显示「已备案管理规约」
- 项目中文名已集中放 enums.js（VERSION_TYPE/REGULATION_TYPE/REGULATION_NAME），组件另写字面量必然漂移

## 解决方案
- 从 enums.js 引 REGULATION_TYPE、REGULATION_NAME，用 getKeyByValue(REGULATION_TYPE, this.regulationType) 取枚举 key，再查 REGULATION_NAME 得中文名，兜底返回「规约」
- 包成 computed（regulationName），按钮用模板字符串 label:`已备案${this.regulationName}`
- 只改文案，权限标识与跳转逻辑一律不动（备案详情/变更页本就按 regulationType 动态生成）

## 与已知差异及验证
- 区别于已知 #856/#734（只讲列表页标题从路由 meta.title 读取），此处标题在业务枚举里，需 getKeyByValue+名称枚举查表
- 排查指引：遇「A 菜单名出现在 B 菜单」先确认是否共用组件，再 grep 组件中文字面量
- 验证：会话 ba726002 用户反馈按钮名错误；修复落唯一硬编码处，node --check 通过；三套规则分别显示已备案管理规约/议事规则/工作规则
- 涉及文件：views/autonomy/regulation/components/index.vue、enums.js、discuss/final/index.vue、work/final/index.vue、regulation/final/index.vue
- 所属项目：苏住房G；来源会话：ba726002-0b18-413d-9066-a944320c62c9；代码基线：9e5c499
